acceptanceCriteria: Journal metadata matches the committed migration set and numbering is coherent enough for future Drizzle operations. Any renumbering is reflected consistently. Verification commands remain green.

findings.detail: The stale OTP scope SQL file (0031_add_otp_verification_scope.sql) was correctly removed from disk, but the corresponding journal entry at idx 32 was left in _journal.json. There are 32 SQL files but 33 journal entries. The suggested verification command exits 1 with extra: ["0031_add_otp_verification_scope"]. The journal entry at lines 229-234 must be removed so the journal is coherent through 0030.
